summary: Valley National Bancorp filed an 8-K reporting the completion of a $500 million offering of 6.219% Fixed-to-Floating Rate Subordinated Notes due 2036, issued under an existing shelf registration statement. The notes are unsecured, subordinated obligations maturing June 1, 2036, with a fixed rate for five years then floating at SOFR plus 243 bps. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation. The filing does not involve M&A, activism, restructuring, or any event-driven catalyst; it is an ordinary shelf takedown to raise regulatory capital.
